name: Pranav Bhounsule
title: Associate Professor
fitReason: Strong CS-methods overlap through transformer routing, policy-gradient learning and robot perception, grounded in actual field execution. More multi-robot autonomy than social HRI or manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: July 7, 2026 paper deploys a REINFORCE-trained transformer planner on an actual X500 quadrotor and Clearpath Husky in a 50 × 50 m outdoor area. A central laptop replans at rendezvous events; ROS 2/Nav2 and PX4 execute vehicle motion. GPT-4o analyzes actual aerial images in a staged hazard-detection example. Important limits: final precision landing is manual, battery recharging is simulated, and the reported 83.33%→20% violation comparison is a separate Gazebo test.

shortVisit.summary: Current lab homepage, last updated September 2, 2025, says no PhD openings and invites current UIC thesis MS students and UIC undergraduates. It does not explicitly offer external short visits. Existing central UIC policy supports a degree-related external-student route, but that is not a faculty invitation.

scoreReasons.fit: 36/40: substantial learned multi-robot planning and perception; less direct HRI/manipulation overlap.
scoreReasons.physical: 25/25: current, specifically documented outdoor hardware execution with operational limits retained.
